title: Desk Guidance: Fees Carried in a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Arrears Payment
content:
**Desk guidance — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract, fees in an arrears payment taken toward an extension.**

**Rule.** When the contract shows a returned payment in the last 12 calendar months and its fees-due balance is above zero, the arrears payment amount also includes an amount equal to the whole fees-due balance; when the contract shows no returned payment in the last 12 calendar months and its fees-due balance is above zero, it includes an amount equal to the fees-due balance up to the product's company maximum late charge of 30.00 dollars (the same 30.00 dollars on Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3, Tier 2, Tier 1 and Tier 1+); in every other case it includes no amount for fees.

The fee amount is added to the arrears payment amount after the arrears share has been applied to the other past-due amount and rounded to the cent.

## Branches

| Returned payment on the contract, last 12 calendar months | Fees-due balance | Amount included for fees |
|---|---|---|
| at least one | above zero | the whole fees-due balance |
| none | above zero | the fees-due balance, but no more than 30.00 dollars |
| either | zero | nothing |

**Counting.** Returned payments are the returned payment entries on the contract's ledger, by their dates. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Fees due 47.00 dollars and a returned payment eight months ago: 47.00 dollars are included.
- Fees due 47.00 dollars and no returned payment in the last 12 calendar months: 30.00 dollars are included.
- Fees due 18.00 dollars and no returned payment in that window: 18.00 dollars are included.
